name: project-operations
description: Evidence-backed project architecture, operational leadership, external research, and continuous improvement for Codex and Obsidian.

interface.shortDescription: Architect, operate, research, and improve projects.
interface.longDescription: A four-role operating system with a persistent core-agent triad: the Solution Architect designs project operations, the Chief of Staff runs evidence-backed control loops, the Researcher discovers repair-first improvements from reputable sources and repositories, and the Upgrader governs implementation and promotion. A bounded Obsidian lifecycle preserves durable progress.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through onboarding a project.
Research evidence-backed ways to repair our current workflows before proposing additions.
Review recent work and improve how this project operates.
